This isn't just jewelry.

It is a proclamation.


Hi, Candice King here — founder of Zaytun.

Two years ago, I started by helping one Palestinian family in Gaza. One became two. Two became ten. Ten became thousands of people facing hunger and displacement.

Among them are mothers, fathers, and children — not only uprooted by violence, but also struggling every day to access food and basic care.

My promise — to you, and to them — is to keep fighting hunger and bringing relief to Palestinians in need.

This Map of Palestine Necklace that you wear helps feed 14 people in Gaza. Thank you for being part of this mission and for turning solidarity into action..
This isn't just jewelry.

It is a proclamation.

Crafted from titanium steel and finished with electroplating, the Map of Palestine Necklace is made to withstand everyday wear while keeping its brilliant shine. Strong, durable, and timeless — just like the resilience of the people it represents.

But this necklace is more than just beautiful. It’s a statement of solidarity, combining lasting quality with a purpose that matters. Every time you wear it, you’re not only honoring Palestine — you’re helping feed families in Gaza and carrying their story with you.

How it works


You buy the Palestine Map

Our Palestine Map necklace comes on a 21cm (inclusive)-50cm O-ring chain. The piece is a timeless embodiment of the lifelong movement.



We provide the meals

From every order, we are able to feed 14 people in need in Gaza. When you buy, you are giving them a chance to survive this genocide.



Locals partners do giving trips

Instead of spending on advertising, we use profits to fund giving trips and document it all on our Instagram.

Your Questions
Thoughtfully answered

What is the Palestine Map necklace made from?

Palestine Map necklace is made from stainless steel and titanium steel making it strong and durable to wear daily.

How long is shipping?

Our jewelry is ship internationally and will arrive on your doorstep within 10-25 days. All of our pieces are hand-packed and sent in our beautifully designed custom packaging.

How much is shipping?

There is no shipping fee. All of our jewlery is shipped internationally at no additional cost at all.

How do you give 14 meals when I buy??

With every necklace purchase, we give 14 meals to Palestinians who have lost everything in Gaza due to the genocide. We do this through the local grassroots partners we have on the ground in Palestine. These organisations are vetted to ensure they provide high quality meals to people that actually need them.

Can I return it?

Yes, we offer free and easy returns for 30 days. If you are unhappy with your Shada Cancer Sun necklace for any reason, just contact us and we'll refund you, hassle-free.
